sources.title: PostgreSQL Range Types
sources.summary: Official PostgreSQL reference for range and multirange types, bounds, operators, indexes, and exclusion constraints.
sources.project_relevance: Defines the tstzrange and [start, end) semantics used to represent booking intervals and detect overlaps.
key_points: Use explicit [) bounds for adjacent bookings.
The && operator detects range overlap.
GiST indexes support efficient range operators.

sources.title: PostgreSQL Constraints
sources.summary: Official PostgreSQL reference for check, unique, primary-key, foreign-key, and exclusion constraints.
sources.project_relevance: Supports end-after-start checks, referential integrity, and database-level exclusion of overlapping confirmed bookings.
key_points: Constraints enforce invariants independently of application races.
Exclusion constraints compare candidate rows with existing rows.
Name constraints so integrity errors can be translated safely.

sources.title: PostgreSQL btree_gist
sources.summary: Official reference for GiST operator classes that provide B-tree-like behavior for data types used in multicolumn GiST indexes.
sources.project_relevance: Enables equality on room_id alongside tstzrange overlap in the booking exclusion constraint.
key_points: Install the extension through a migration.
Combine scalar equality with range overlap in one GiST exclusion constraint.
Treat extension availability as a PostgreSQL integration concern.

sources.title: PostgreSQL Transaction Isolation
sources.summary: Official PostgreSQL guide to transaction isolation levels, serialization behavior, and concurrency anomalies.
sources.project_relevance: Explains why a pre-check alone cannot prevent concurrent double booking and why constraint failures require rollback.
key_points: Concurrent transactions can observe changing data depending on isolation.
Correctness must survive races between pre-check and insert.
Retry or error handling must respect transaction state.

sources.title: PostgreSQL Date/Time Types
sources.summary: Official PostgreSQL reference for date/time types, input, output, time zones, and timestamp behavior.
sources.project_relevance: Guides storage of booking instants as TIMESTAMPTZ while office-local interpretation remains explicit at system boundaries.
key_points: Use timestamp with time zone for booking instants.
Require timezone-aware API inputs.
Separate stored instants from local display and natural-language interpretation.

sources.title: FastAPI Documentation
sources.summary: Official FastAPI documentation for typed HTTP APIs, dependencies, validation integration, errors, and async endpoints.
sources.project_relevance: Supports the /api/v1 contract, authentication dependencies, consistent errors, and thin router boundaries.
key_points: Keep HTTP adaptation in routers and domain rules in services.
Use dependencies for request-scoped authentication and sessions.
Expose typed request and response contracts.

sources.title: Pydantic Documentation
sources.summary: Official Pydantic documentation for typed models, validation, serialization, and settings patterns.
sources.project_relevance: Defines API schemas and validates untrusted DeepSeek JSON before separate business validation.
key_points: Schema validity is not the same as domain validity.
Reject or clarify missing critical BookingIntent fields.
Use strict, explicit models at trust boundaries.

sources.title: SQLAlchemy AsyncIO
sources.summary: Official SQLAlchemy 2 documentation for asyncio engines, AsyncSession lifecycle, transactions, and ORM use.
sources.project_relevance: Guides request-scoped database sessions, BookingService transactions, rollback, and concurrency-safe persistence.
key_points: Do not share one AsyncSession across concurrent tasks.
Keep transaction ownership explicit.
Rollback after integrity errors before reusing a session.

sources.title: Alembic Documentation
sources.summary: Official Alembic documentation for database schema migrations with SQLAlchemy.
sources.project_relevance: Owns reproducible creation of tables, btree_gist, booking constraints, and forward/backward schema evolution.
key_points: Review generated migrations before applying them.
Use explicit operations for PostgreSQL-specific extensions and exclusion constraints.
Test upgrade paths on an empty real PostgreSQL database.

sources.title: JSON Web Token (JWT) RFC 7519
sources.summary: The standards-track definition of JSON Web Tokens and registered claim names.
sources.project_relevance: Provides the token format used for short-lived access tokens while authorization remains enforced by backend ownership checks.
key_points: Validate signature and required claims.
Use expiration deliberately.
A valid token does not replace resource authorization.

sources.title: OWASP Authentication Cheat Sheet
sources.summary: OWASP guidance for designing and implementing secure authentication controls.
sources.project_relevance: Guides registration/login behavior, credential handling, authentication errors, and abuse-resistant defaults.
key_points: Use consistent authentication responses where disclosure matters.
Protect authentication data in transit and logs.
Treat inactive users and failed credentials deliberately.

sources.title: OWASP Password Storage Cheat Sheet
sources.summary: OWASP guidance for modern password hashing algorithms and operational parameters.
sources.project_relevance: Supports the required pwdlib/Argon2 password storage design and prohibits reversible or plaintext credential storage.
key_points: Prefer Argon2id where available.
Store password hashes, never plaintext passwords.
Choose and revisit work factors deliberately.

sources.title: OWASP REST Security Cheat Sheet
sources.summary: OWASP guidance for REST API authentication, authorization, input validation, status codes, and operational security.
sources.project_relevance: Guides authorization for booking ownership, safe error responses, input validation, and sensitive-log avoidance.
key_points: Authorize every protected operation server-side.
Validate all untrusted input.
Do not expose secrets or internal details in errors and logs.

sources.title: DeepSeek API Documentation
sources.summary: Official DeepSeek API documentation for request formats, models, endpoints, and API behavior.
sources.project_relevance: Defines the external parser integration that converts natural language into a BookingIntent preview only.
key_points: Keep API configuration outside source control.
Bound calls with timeouts.
Map provider failures without breaking manual booking.

sources.title: DeepSeek JSON Output
sources.summary: Official DeepSeek guide for requesting JSON-formatted model output and handling its constraints.
sources.project_relevance: Supports structured BookingIntent extraction while requiring JSON parsing, Pydantic validation, and domain validation afterward.
key_points: A JSON response is still untrusted input.
Handle empty or malformed output.
Prompt for the expected shape and validate every field.

sources.title: OpenAI Python SDK
sources.summary: Official repository and usage documentation for the OpenAI Python client library.
sources.project_relevance: If used with DeepSeek's compatible API, provides client mechanics; DeepSeek-specific behavior remains governed by DeepSeek documentation.
key_points: Configure base URL and credentials explicitly.
Set bounded timeout and failure handling.
Hide the concrete client behind BookingIntentParser.

sources.title: React Documentation
sources.summary: Official React documentation for components, state, effects, rendering, and application composition.
sources.project_relevance: Supports a clear component model for authentication, room schedules, booking forms, previews, and result states.
key_points: Keep rendering deterministic.
Avoid duplicating server-derived state in effects.
Separate interaction state from server state.

sources.title: TypeScript Documentation
sources.summary: Official TypeScript documentation for static types, narrowing, modules, and compiler behavior.
sources.project_relevance: Provides compile-time contracts for API payloads, UI states, and booking-preview flows.
key_points: Model loading, success, empty, and error states explicitly.
Do not use frontend types as runtime validation.
Keep API contract types aligned with backend schemas.

sources.title: Vite Guide
sources.summary: Official Vite guide for local development, environment variables, static builds, and plugins.
sources.project_relevance: Defines the frontend development and production build that Nginx serves in the composed runtime.
key_points: Only explicitly exposed client variables reach browser code.
Build static assets for Nginx.
Keep the browser API base path on the single-origin /api route.

sources.title: Material UI Documentation
sources.summary: Official Material UI documentation for React UI components, theming, form controls, and feedback patterns.
sources.project_relevance: Supports an accessible functional interface for forms, previews, conflicts, alternatives, and status feedback.
key_points: Use semantic labels and accessible controls.
Represent loading and errors visibly.
Favor standard components over custom decoration.

sources.title: TanStack Query for React
sources.summary: Official TanStack Query overview for fetching, caching, synchronizing, and mutating server state in React.
sources.project_relevance: Owns room, schedule, availability, and booking server state plus invalidation after create or cancel.
key_points: Invalidate affected queries after successful mutations.
Keep server state out of ad hoc global state.
Show pending and error states from query lifecycle.

sources.title: React Hook Form Documentation
sources.summary: Official React Hook Form documentation for managing form state, validation, submission, and errors.
sources.project_relevance: Supports login, registration, manual booking, and editable AI preview forms without moving business rules into the browser.
key_points: Keep client validation focused on fast feedback.
Display backend field and domain errors.
Preserve user input across recoverable failures.

sources.title: Zod Documentation
sources.summary: Official Zod documentation for TypeScript-first runtime schemas and parsing.
sources.project_relevance: Validates browser form and API-response shapes while backend validation remains authoritative.
key_points: Use runtime parsing where external data enters the frontend.
Infer TypeScript types from schemas where helpful.
Do not duplicate backend domain decisions.

sources.title: pytest Documentation
sources.summary: Official pytest documentation for test discovery, fixtures, parametrization, assertions, and plugins.
sources.project_relevance: Provides the backend test harness for domain rules, APIs, migrations, concurrency, and mocked parser behavior.
key_points: Parametrize booking interval boundaries.
Use fixtures with explicit lifecycle.
Keep failure assertions specific to behavior.

sources.title: Testcontainers for Python
sources.summary: Testcontainers for Python documentation for disposable container-backed integration dependencies.
sources.project_relevance: Enables tests against real PostgreSQL for exclusion constraints, migrations, and concurrent booking races.
key_points: Do not substitute SQLite for PostgreSQL behavior.
Apply migrations to the test database.
Make container lifecycle deterministic and isolated.

sources.title: Playwright Documentation
sources.summary: Official Playwright documentation for reliable browser automation and end-to-end testing.
sources.project_relevance: Covers manual booking/conflict and AI preview/confirm user journeys through the composed application.
key_points: Prefer user-visible locators and outcomes.
Keep E2E focused on critical cross-layer flows.
Capture useful traces for failures without exposing secrets.

sources.title: Docker Compose Documentation
sources.summary: Official Docker Compose documentation for defining and running multi-container applications.
sources.project_relevance: Defines one-command startup for PostgreSQL, migrations, seed, backend, and Nginx-served frontend.
key_points: Use healthchecks and dependency conditions deliberately.
Keep secrets outside committed Compose defaults.
Verify startup from a clean state.

sources.title: NGINX Reverse Proxy Guide
sources.summary: Official NGINX guide for proxying requests and forwarding request metadata to upstream services.
sources.project_relevance: Supports serving the SPA and proxying /api to FastAPI through one browser origin.
key_points: Forward required proxy headers explicitly.
Keep API and static-route behavior unambiguous.
Test SPA fallback separately from API routing.

sources.title: Ruff Documentation
sources.summary: Official Ruff documentation for Python linting, formatting, configuration, and editor/CI use.
sources.project_relevance: Provides fast, reproducible backend formatting and lint gates locally and in CI.
key_points: Keep local and CI configuration identical.
Run format checks and lint checks explicitly.
Fix findings rather than broadly suppressing them.

sources.title: Pyright Documentation
sources.summary: Official Pyright documentation for Python static type checking and configuration.
sources.project_relevance: Checks typed API, service, repository, and parser contracts before runtime.
key_points: Type trust-boundary models precisely.
Keep async return and optional types explicit.
Do not hide real errors with blanket ignores.

sources.title: GitHub Actions Documentation
sources.summary: Official GitHub documentation for workflows, jobs, actions, environments, and secrets.
sources.project_relevance: Runs backend, frontend, PostgreSQL integration, E2E where practical, and Docker build gates.
key_points: Use least-privilege workflow permissions.
Keep secrets in supported secret stores.
Make CI commands match documented local gates.

sources.title: The Twelve-Factor App: Config
sources.summary: The Twelve-Factor App guidance for separating deploy-varying configuration from code.
sources.project_relevance: Supports environment-based database, JWT, timezone, and DeepSeek settings without committed credentials.
key_points: Keep deploy-specific values out of source code.
Document required variables in .env.example.
Do not group sensitive production values into committed profiles.

sources.title: Google Site Reliability Engineering Book
sources.summary: Google's SRE book covering reliability principles, monitoring, incident response, and operating distributed services.
sources.project_relevance: Frames lightweight health endpoints, structured logs, request IDs, and isolation of optional DeepSeek failures.
key_points: Expose signals tied to user-visible reliability.
Separate required dependency readiness from optional integration health.
Prefer actionable logs and bounded failure domains.
